limits: Web callback without session and empty code_verifier, duplicate empty code_verifier mobile classification, auto-registration success, provider error, callback state replay, expired ID token, email linking, auto-registration denial, invalid nonce/issuer/audience/signature, selected admin-only user_added event, mobile redirect allowlist/PKCE errors, valid mobile token exchange, consumed-flow callback replay, mobile redirect state replay, and invalid mobile PKCE verifier failure plus replay are exercised.

Selected web/mobile start and successful callback cookies are compared by name/stable value/Max-Age/Path/Expires/HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite and signed connect.sid. JWT algorithms/claims are compared, normalizing only UUID identifiers and timestamps; each ID-token nonce is checked against its own authorization request. In-memory flow-state expiry, failure/logout cookie clearing, other callback variants, and general Socket.IO inventory remain unverified.

Persisted user fields and session counts are compared; only fixture-specific backup paths, UUID identifiers, and timestamps are normalized. JSON object member order is canonicalized only for Socket.IO event payloads; arrays, scalar values, null/empty distinctions, and raw persisted extraData text remain strict.
